what: R129 air control and landing tiers (P1-FL07; docs/research/fun-tracks.md R14-R16) on the Feel Lab's canyon leap: a Cruz Missile takes the kicker flat out down its middle at 22 m/s, lifts off the throttle at the lip (tick 66) and flies the gap; it floors it again once down (tick 260). The three fixtures fly the same jump three ways (air-pitch-neutral, -down, -up). Nose down: a 0.18 s tap of throttle in the air (ticks 90-112, a human's reaction after the lip) pitches the nose down to meet the landing slope, so all four wheels land within 8 degrees of it: a clean landing, whose boost leaves it well faster than the neutral run 0.75 s later.
